main_reasons: Plain-vanilla community bank (~$1.3B assets) with simple, transparent balance sheet: loans, AFS securities, deposits; no complex instruments or off-balance-sheet structures

Earnings doubling largely explained by non-recurring 2024 merger costs ($2.4M), full-year JCB contribution and NIM expansion from asset repricing; rate/volume tables, average balances and income statement reconcile
Credit metrics are benign and internally consistent (NPLs 0.45%, net charge-offs 0.01%, substandard loans rising modestly and disclosed); ACL at 0.82% is thin but supported by very low loss history
Strong operating cash flow relative to earnings, tax rate reconciles, parent-only statements tie to consolidated equity
Long-tenured auditor (Elliott Davis since 1995) with clean opinion; only CAM is routine ACL qualitative factors

Minor governance soft spots: no ICFR auditor attestation (non-accelerated filer), no designated audit committee financial expert, no formal related-party policy, aging board, related-party loans ~10% of equity
No restatements, error-correction checkboxes, auditor changes, material weaknesses or unusual accounting judgments disclosed
